export.record_note: Scenario configuration export authored for this exercise. Monitor definitions reference columns in the EIA-930 six-month BALANCE files.

monitors.name: BALANCE feed freshness
monitors.rule: demand missing for more than 3 consecutive hours

monitors.name: Demand floor and ceiling
monitors.rule: demand reported as zero or negative, or at least 1.5 times the BA's highest previously accepted demand

monitors.name: Demand vs day-ahead forecast deviation
monitors.rule: abs(actual - reference) / reference > 20% for an hour
